description: The routes the generated kernel router registers for one entity, as (method, path template). {base} is DomainMetadata.effectivePath(); {action} is kebab(@Action name). CrudRouteParityE2ETest (exeris-e2e-tests) proves the generated router and the OpenAPI document serve exactly these and that the generated Java client calls only these; crud-route-parity.spec.ts (exeris-codegen-ts) proves the generated TypeScript service calls only these. The two builds never run together, so this file is the one place they meet: change it only together with the router.
